css: .chrome-bar { left:940px; top:270px; width:820px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:26px 30px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:24px } .chrome-play { width:64px; height:64px; flex:none; border-radius:50%; background:var(--jade); color:var(--ground); font-size:26px; line-height:64px; text-align:center } .chrome-track { flex:1; height:12px; border-radius:6px; background:var(--hair); position:relative } .chrome-fill { position:absolute; left:0; top:0; bottom:0; width:45%; border-radius:6px; background:var(--jade) } .chrome-dots { display:flex; gap:10px } .chrome-dots i { width:18px; height:18px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--hair) } .chrome-dots i:first-child { background:var(--main) } .chrome-cc { font-size:24px; font-weight:600; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:8px; background:var(--main); color:var(--ground); white-space:nowrap } .chrome-mini { top:470px; width:260px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:18px } .chrome-screen { height:120px; border-radius:10px; background:var(--shade) } .chrome-strip { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px; margin-top:14px } .chrome-strip i { width:26px; height:26px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--jade); flex:none } .chrome-strip span { flex:1; height:10px; border-radius:5px; background:var(--hair) }
